test_train_and_eval_overfit: test the train_pmap.train and train_pmap.evaluate functions with test data and verify accuracy reaches 1.0

run_train_pmap_evaluate: run train_pmap.evaluate with data_path, master_csv_path, split_path, and save_dir arguments to return loss and accuracy

review_train_pmap_device_batch: review the train_pmap.device_batch function that batches graphs across JAX local devices
